use_case: Predictive maintenance for non-safety plant equipment: anomaly detection, fault classification, and remaining-useful-life estimates for 38 balance-of-plant assets (circulating water pumps, condensate pumps, heater drain pumps, instrument air compressors, turbine building ventilation fans, main transformer cooling fans)
vendor_or_model: Predictive maintenance vendor (machine learning models on vendor SaaS; vendor sensor gateway with clamp-on wireless sensors; cloud connector sending historian-derived data)
data_categories: Vibration and temperature from wireless sensors; selected plant process values from the historian replica through the cloud analytics platform (outbound only); work order history without technician names. No personal data, no SGI, no SRI
consequential_decision_category: None about individuals; critical infrastructure operations (a missed failure on these assets could cause a unit trip or derate)
human_in_the_loop: Alerts create draft work orders only; a maintenance planner and the system engineer review each one; the Maintenance Manager approves any schedule change; time-based preventive maintenance and the Maintenance Rule program are never reduced because of model output
applicable_laws: 10 CFR 73.54(b)(1) and (d)(3) (CST evaluation of the gateway and the data feed); 10 CFR 50.65 (Maintenance Rule program stays the basis for monitoring assets in its scope); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims). No NRC rule specific to AI use was identified
status: Pilot since 2026-02 (38 assets); approved with conditions due 2026-11-30; no expansion until met

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant in the productivity suite: drafting, summarizing, and searching business documents
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite vendor generative AI assistant (large language model; tenant data boundary; no training on company data under the enterprise terms)
data_categories: Internal and Confidential business documents; email and chat content of the user. Not cleared for Restricted information (SRI, access authorization files), SGI, or export-controlled technology
human_in_the_loop: Users review every output; any output used in NRC correspondence, procedures, engineering documents, or HR decisions is reviewed by the document owner under the normal review and approval process
applicable_laws: POL-04 4.3 and POL-05 4.5 (no Restricted data); 10 CFR 73.21-73.22 (SGI never on the business network); 10 CFR Part 810 and Part 110 (export-controlled technology excluded; handled by the export compliance program); Fla. Stat. 501.171 if personal information were exposed
status: Licensed (existing); rollout to all staff with training by 2026-12-31; public generative AI sites blocked at the web proxy by 2026-12-31

use_case: CAP screening assistant: suggests a significance level and a responsible department for new condition reports
vendor_or_model: Optional AI module of the CAP software (language model running on the company CAP server; no data leaves the site)
data_categories: Condition report text and equipment identifiers. Security-related condition reports are to be excluded (they can contain SRI)
affects_individuals: Indirectly (reporters and owners named in reports)
consequential_decision_category: None about individuals; supports regulated decisions (corrective action screening)
human_in_the_loop: The screening committee decides every classification; from 2026-11 screeners record their own classification before the suggestion is shown
applicable_laws: 10 CFR 50 Appendix B Criterion XVI (conditions adverse to quality promptly identified; significant conditions get cause and corrective action); 10 CFR 73.77(b) (cyber security program entries within 24 hours); POL-04 4.3
status: Pilot since 2026-05 on non-security reports; approved with conditions due 2026-12-31

use_case: Applicant ranking feature in the applicant tracking SaaS: scores and orders applicants against the job posting
vendor_or_model: Applicant tracking SaaS vendor (machine learning ranking model; enabled by vendor default in 2026-03)
data_categories: Resumes, application answers, work history, education; may correlate with protected characteristics
human_in_the_loop: Today: recruiters say they review all applications, but this is not documented. Required: feature off until the adverse impact analysis passes; then recruiters must review every applicant who meets minimum qualifications, and no applicant is rejected on the score alone
applicable_laws: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 (disparate impact); 29 CFR Part 1607 (Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures, including the four-fifths rule in 1607.4(D)); Americans with Disabilities Act (accommodation in the application process); 10 CFR 73.56 (ranking never substitutes for the access authorization determination); state AI employment laws for out-of-state applicants under counsel review
status: Disable by 2026-10-31 pending adverse impact analysis and a written human review rule

use_case: Power price forecasting: day-ahead and monthly price forecasts used for scheduling and outage timing analysis
vendor_or_model: Power price forecasting vendor (machine learning forecasts on vendor SaaS)
data_categories: Public market data; company generation schedule and planned outage dates (Confidential)
human_in_the_loop: Traders review every schedule; outage dates are set by the Plant General Manager and the outage organization, never by the forecast
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims); PPA confidentiality terms for schedule data
status: In production since 2024; approved; Low risk accepted (P01 R-025)
